page.layout: One column of verse, with italic headings between the stanzas. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Signature at the foot right. Handwritten ink annotations in the right margin and at the foot are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: [?]bfumens hominem pectore saucio:
Circæoque potens addere te gregi.
Tollitur ut volucri motu scintilla, ruenti
Celsa sed est lapsu facta repente nihil:
Ingenio sic tu quicunque tumescis, & audes
Doctrinæ nil non attribuisse tuæ:
Ni moderata sapis, conclusus pectore fungus
Erumpet, vanus dissiliétque tumor.

l.i: Corpus expers animæ. Anima sine pietate

main_text.l: Cernis ut immunda fœtens putredine corpus
Soluitur, & tetris vermibus esca iacet?
Nimirum vacuum est animæ; quæ membra
gubernans
Felici religet viuida temperie.
Est sua mors animæ: vitii quam pessima labes
Gignit, in ardenti flammea facta foco.
Huic etenim pietas vitam ni pura ministret,
Exitio languet corruitura graui.
Ecquid membra iuuant in corpore pulchra
decoro, Infirmum si sit vel sine mente caput?
Quid populo profunt sancti consulta Senatus,
Si non sint regis robore fulta boni?
Squalet ut abductis tellus, licet alma, colonis,
Et præter spinas nil tribulósque parit:

page.notes: Left edge of the scan cuts off the first letters of the lines, so the first letter of line one is doubtful. "sancti consulta" is an overprinted or blotted word and is doubtful. Handwritten Greek and ink marks in the margins and at the foot were not transcribed.
